decision: Sam's explicit decision of 2026-11-02 ("全部按你的建議執行", Claude Code session f804490c) re-confirming his 2026-10-30 option-A approval of TASK-010 routine-CI cases for these exact blobs, narrowed by HD-011 from 11 to 10 new cases; recorded in docs/purchasing_receiving_management/implementation/P1_task010_config_validation.md
purpose: Purchasing config fails startup on invalid values; shared input validators reject unsafe IDs, dates, event IDs, text and client-supplied projections without echoing the submitted value
data: In-memory literals only; largest loop 1000 crypto.randomUUID() samples; no database, network or fixture files
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main
cost: Measured about 0.12 s wall per new file locally, mostly Node startup; CI not measured, estimated under 1 s per job; no new job

cases: TASK-010 the defaults are the §12.1 values and the result is frozen
TASK-010 every setting must be a positive safe integer within its limit
TASK-010 unknown settings and schema-bound constants cannot be configured
TASK-010 IDs are positive safe integers
TASK-010 eventId is a canonical lowercase UUID the Inventory provider will accept
TASK-010 dates are real calendar days in YYYY-MM-DD
TASK-010 reason is trimmed to 5..500 characters; notes and references are bounded free text
TASK-010 objects are allowlisted, so client totals, snapshots and status never get through
TASK-010 line and detail arrays need at least one item and respect the configured cap
TASK-010 errors carry a stable code and a field name, never the submitted value
global configuration validation normalizes every configuration section
